phases.objective: Require one read-only exact-merge-candidate closure across every registered derived-state family, block only stale semantic artifacts or safety failures, and defer non-blocking observability publication to post-merge governed convergence.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact merge candidate has zero blocking derived-state objections; semantic stale state is repaired through registered trusted authorities, while Repository Inventory and Evaluation may remain advisory observability until post-merge publication.
steps: Checkout the exact GitHub merge candidate with persisted credentials disabled and read-only repository permission.
Validate the governance registry, dependency DAG, verifier allowlist, and registered repair authorities before running derived-state checks.
Run each verifier read-only in dependency order and fail closed if any verifier mutates the worktree.
Classify every result by artifact_class and explicit merge_blocking rather than treating every stale artifact identically.
Record stale Repository Inventory and Repository Evaluation as advisory observability when merge_blocking=false; do not dispatch a pre-merge writer for them.
Treat stale semantic artifacts such as Work Maps as blocking and expose only their registered repair authority.
For a blocking repair, bind the trusted workflow_run to one same-repository PR, exact current head, current main base, and one authority per convergence pass.
Require manual merge for changes to the automation control surface so the control plane cannot silently approve its own amendment.
After a trusted writer changes the PR head, request a fresh exact-merge-candidate closure and reject stale receipts.
After source merge, publish observability artifacts only through the registered post-merge convergence recipe on a non-protected branch.
Never directly push to main or Production, force-push, use --admin merge, mutate databases/providers, or expose credentials.
assertions: Derived State Closure evaluates the exact merge candidate and has no path filter that can hide repository-wide dependencies.
Verifier commands are code-owned and cannot be injected from the registry.
Verifier-created worktree changes are blocking safety failures.
Repository Inventory is observability with merge_blocking=false and stale pre-merge state is advisory.
Repository Evaluation is observability with merge_blocking=false and stale pre-merge state is advisory.
Observability artifacts are published post-merge only and never mutate the feature branch to converge a merge candidate.
Semantic artifacts remain merge blocking; stale Work Maps resolve to spec_kit_work_map_autofix and cannot be downgraded by observability policy.
A failed exact candidate can dispatch only one registered blocking repair authority per convergence pass and no more than the configured maximum.
Automation-control changes require manual merge and cannot auto-repair or auto-merge themselves.
Auto-merge, where permitted for non-control-plane changes, requires a current receipt bound to the current PR head and current main base and never uses --admin.
Post-merge Repository State convergence uses repository_inventory_refresh on a non-protected branch and preserves exact-head verification.
Protected-branch mutation, force push, Production mutation, database mutation, provider mutation, and secret publication remain forbidden.

phases.objective: Observe bounded blocking repair and post-merge observability publication under the v2 closure policy.
Exercise stale receipts, main drift, verifier mutation, unknown authority, nondeterminism, and post-push readback mismatch paths.
Use a governed non-protected convergence branch as the canary for post-merge observability publication.
Require same-SHA closure, staging eligibility, source pin, and explicit authorization before Production promotion.
